description: Pinterest conversion tag requests to ct.pinterest.com, including the noscript image fallback.

params.name: tid
params.description: It is the Pinterest conversion tag ID.
params.fix_hint: Copy the tag ID from Ads Manager into `tid`.

params.name: event
params.description: The base code omits it; event code sends one. Custom event names are allowed, so check that an unrecognized value is deliberate and not a misspelled standard event.

params.name: noscript
params.description: The image fallback in the base code sends `noscript=1`.

params.name: ed[value]
params.description: It is the purchase value on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[value]` on checkout and add to cart tags.
params.fix_hint: Send a number in `ed[value]`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: ed[currency]
params.description: It is the ISO 4217 currency of `ed[value]`. Pinterest documents `ed[currency]` on the image tag.
params.fix_hint: Send a three-letter currency code in `ed[currency]`, such as `USD`.

params.name: ed[order_quantity]
params.description: It is the order quantity on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[order_quantity]` next to `ed[value]`.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer item count in `ed[order_quantity]`.

params.name: ed[event_id]
params.description: It is the event id on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[event_id]` for deduplication against the JavaScript tag.
params.fix_hint: Send the same event id the JavaScript tag fired, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: pd[em]
params.description: It is the hashed email for Enhanced Match on the image tag. Pinterest documents SHA-256 hex after lowercase and trim. The JavaScript tag hashes in the browser; the img tag does not.
params.fix_hint: Lowercase and trim the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest in `pd[em]`.

params.name: pd[external_id]
params.description: It is the hashed advertiser-side user id for Enhanced Match on the image tag. Pinterest documents SHA-256 hex.
params.fix_hint: Hash the identifier with SHA-256 and send the hex digest in `pd[external_id]`.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_price]
params.description: It is a line-item price on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_price]` as a number.
params.fix_hint: Send a number in `ed[line_items][n][product_price]`, without a currency symbol.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_quantity]
params.description: It is a line-item quantity on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_quantity]` as an integer.
params.fix_hint: Send an integer item count in `ed[line_items][n][product_quantity]`.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_name]
params.description: It is a line-item name on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_name]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the product name in `ed[line_items][n][product_name]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_id]
params.description: It is a line-item product id on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_id]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the catalog product id in `ed[line_items][n][product_id]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_category]
params.description: It is a line-item category on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_category]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the category in `ed[line_items][n][product_category]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_variant_id]
params.description: It is a line-item variant id on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_variant_id]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the variant id in `ed[line_items][n][product_variant_id]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_variant]
params.description: It is a line-item variant name on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_variant]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the variant name in `ed[line_items][n][product_variant]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[line_items][0][product_brand]
params.description: It is a line-item brand on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[line_items][n][product_brand]` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the brand in `ed[line_items][n][product_brand]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[order_id]
params.description: It is the order id on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `order_id` as a string for conversion reporting.
params.fix_hint: Send the order id in `ed[order_id]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[promo_code]
params.description: It is a promotion code on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `promo_code` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the code in `ed[promo_code]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[property]
params.description: It is the store or property name on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `property` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the property name in `ed[property]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[search_query]
params.description: It is the search string on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `ed[search_query]` on search tags.
params.fix_hint: Send the query in `ed[search_query]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[video_title]
params.description: It is the video title on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `video_title` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the title in `ed[video_title]`, or drop the empty pair.

params.name: ed[lead_type]
params.description: It is the lead type on the noscript image. Pinterest documents `lead_type` as a string.
params.fix_hint: Send the lead type in `ed[lead_type]`, or drop the empty pair.

rules.message: A checkout or add-to-cart tag is missing `ed[value]` or `ed[currency]`. Pinterest documents those keys on the image tag for conversion reporting.
rules.fix_hint: Add `ed[value]` and `ed[currency]` to the noscript image, or fire the event from JavaScript.
